generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential unique integers starting at 1; never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: Copy an existing parent key; NOT NULL FK columns always reference a parent (unless the parent-side parent-without-children target is required); nullable FK columns get NULL in ~10% of rows.
generic_sampling_rules.int_quantity: Integer in [0, 10000]; include boundary values at each listed literal (one step on each side).
generic_sampling_rules.int_years: Integer in [0, 40]; include boundary values 2,3,4,9,10,11 (negatives -8,-7,-6 are unrealizable under the >= 0 rule and are not generated).
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Random combination of first/last names; unique per table where PK-adjacent; case/whitespace near-variants only on filler rows outside shaped groups.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short_enum: Pick from a small explicit pool; case-variants only on filler rows outside shaped groups and only where the column is not NULL-exempt.
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: Format 'D Month YYYY' (e.g. '13 October 2008'); random date in [2000-01-01, 2020-12-31].
generic_sampling_rules.text_free: Random short string; near-duplicates only on filler rows outside shaped groups.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For every nullable column (including those marked null_exempt in shape/tie protection): plant a NULL at the compact per-column NULL fraction, and at least one NULL row per nullable column per instance, even when the compact share is 0. Planted NULLs are never replaced by shape/tie logic. Exempt columns (event, journalist, news_report) are exempt from the shape/tie protection only; the NULL rule still applies to every nullable column. Rules and formulas constrain only non-NULL operands.

targets.group_sizes: 1, 2 and >= 3 (shape [1,1,2,3] = 7 rows; leaves 4 filler rows for case-variants)
targets.null_planting: NULL on the singleton filler row only; case-variant substitution applied to the remaining filler rows with probability >= 0.5 so that at least one row carries 'england' and one carries 'wales'.

targets.tie_note: rank-1 tie: at least two rows share the maximum Years_working. rank-1000 tie is vacuous at size 11.
targets.null_planting: NULL on the singleton filler row only; the rank-1 tie is preserved.
NULL on the singleton filler row only; near-variants only on filler rows.

targets.qualifying_rows: >= 2 per venue group with different attendance values
targets.tie_note: tie at rank 2 over DESC ordering must hold; vary values within each venue group (per1, per1+1, ...) while keeping SUM(event_attendance) equal across two venue groups. Verify the rank-2 tie after the venue-sum adjustment.
targets.null_planting: NULL on the singleton filler venue row only; the two SUM-tie venue groups are never NULL.
NULL on the singleton filler row only; rank-1 tie preserved.

targets.tie_note: two venue groups must have equal attendance sums; do not NULL any row of the tie groups.
targets.null_planting: NULL on the singleton filler venue only; the two SUM-tie venue groups are never NULL.
